system.description:
Covers most medium levels of metal armor, including scale and brigandine. True chain-mail is rare in the modern age, but many elders and some mortal Inquisitors keep a suit on hand.

Negative Traits: Heavy

Availability: Any - generally must be custom made, and can cost upward of $500 or more.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Rules, Systems and Drama
